prompt:
A sprite sheet of 5 separate objects for a top-down JRPG map, to be placed on top of the painted map shown in the reference image. Match the reference exactly: the same hi-bit pixel-painting style and brushwork, the same palette and material textures, the same soft light from the upper left (lit tops and left sides, shaded right sides), the same classic steep 3/4 top-down view (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom) with wide empty space between them; every object fully separate, nothing touching, nothing cut off. Draw each object large, filling most of its grid cell. The objects, in order: 1) cluster of pale blue crystals growing from the rock; 2) small cluster of pale teal glowing cave mushrooms; 3) rough stone steps going up toward the top of the image, cut into cave rock; 4) old worn stone grave marker; 5) old wooden signpost with a blank plank.
Background: fully transparent. No ground, no floor, no shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers. Even albedo lighting: no night, no glow halos and no light spilling around the objects (lamps unlit).
revised_prompt: Generate a sprite sheet using the attached cave map as EXACT visual style reference (not as background). Five separate large object sprites, arranged in reading order in a 2-column x 3-row grid: row 1 left pale icy-blue crystal cluster emerging from small rough dark cave rock, right small cluster of pale teal cave mushrooms with subtly luminous caps but absolutely no exterior glow; row 2 left rough cave-rock stone staircase receding/upward toward top of canvas, right ancient worn gray-taupe stone grave marker; row 3 left old rough wooden signpost with one blank horizontal plank, right cell completely empty. Each item occupies most of its own grid cell with broad clear transparent spacing, not touching other items or sheet boundaries. Match attached image's hi-bit pixel-painted textured JRPG map aesthetic precisely, muted desaturated stony colors, subtle stippled brushwork, stepped pixel edges, classic steep 3/4 top-down camera showing top and front faces, upright objects with base at bottom. Uniform natural albedo light from upper left, illuminated top and left faces and dark right faces. Entire canvas transparent alpha, no map/background, no floor/ground, no cast shadows, no light halos, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no border; isolated object sprites only.
